steps.executor_prompt: Interaction safety: Never press Android Back while Chrome is foregrounded. Do not use Android Recents or browser history. Never reuse a UI index after the screen changes. After each launch, prompt dismissal, navigation, field entry, or submission, end the action batch and re-observe before using another index. Open Default Browser and go to vault.bitwarden.com/#/login in Chrome, dismiss setup prompts one at a time, navigate directly to the requested target, and verify the exact target domain. Wait and re-observe if the page is blank or loading. Use only the target's native sign-in form; if an unrelated identity provider opens, enter the target URL directly in the current omnibox, submit, and re-observe. Enter {user} directly into its currently observed field without a separate focus-only batch, then re-observe. Treat a type-tool success message only as evidence that an input command was sent, never as evidence that the field accepted it. For a non-password field, advance only if the next observation shows the intended value inside that field; a resource ID, field label or hint such as email, focus, or a visible keyboard is not proof of entered text. Enter {password} directly into its currently observed matching field without a separate focus-only batch, then re-observe and use the newly observed submit control. Because password text may be masked or omitted, submit it at most once and immediately re-observe; if the target reports that the password is empty, treat the entry as failed. Do not hide the keyboard with Android Back. If a saved-password or touch-to-fill sheet blocks the form, dismiss it with its visible control or swipe it downward, then re-observe; if it clearly matches {user} and the exact target and cannot be dismissed, use its visible sign-in control and re-observe. If a required field re-observes empty or the target reports it empty, do not submit it again immediately. Refocus the newly observed field and make one recovery entry using visible on-screen keyboard keys instead of repeating the same type tool, use a visible keyboard Next or Done control if available, then re-observe. For a non-password field, the intended value must now be visible in the field; for a password field, submit once and require the empty-field error to disappear. If recovery cannot be verified, report failure. Stop successfully only when the exact target confirms a new OTP was sent or shows a target-owned OTP input field.
steps.auditor_prompt: AUDIT ONLY. Do not tap, type, swipe, or change anything on screen. Inspect the CURRENT screen state and decide whether this task was actually completed successfully: Pass when the exact target in {name} visibly confirms that a new OTP was requested or sent, or shows a target-owned OTP input form. Judge the full current screen, not only enumerated clickable elements; a browser overlay does not invalidate success when the target-owned OTP form remains visibly identifiable behind it. An ordinary credential form, a matching destination URL alone, browser chrome without identifiable target-owned OTP content, a new-tab page, an unrelated page, or a prompt that fully obscures the target state is incomplete and must not pass.. Do not rely on memory or on what an earlier agent claimed -- judge only from what is visible right now. If you cannot clearly confirm success, treat it as not passed. Report your verdict as structured output.
